about: What scripts/release/package_release.py publishes and what sim/paired_stats.py compares. Paths are relative to the repository root of the machine that flew the evaluations (~/Aero-VPA on the VM). Nothing listed here is committed to git.

checkpoints.name: r1
checkpoints.description: DAgger round 1 (flown by the BC policy v2): demonstrations + round 1, all proprioceptive inputs

checkpoints.name: r2
checkpoints.description: DAgger round 2 (flown by r1): demonstrations + rounds 1-2, all inputs

checkpoints.name: noact
checkpoints.description: demonstrations + DAgger rounds 1-3; last command withheld from the selector and the solver

checkpoints.name: nomotion
checkpoints.description: demonstrations + DAgger rounds 1-3; last command and velocity withheld

checkpoints.name: sd
checkpoints.description: demonstrations + DAgger rounds 1-3; all inputs, velocity and last command dropped in 50% of the training frames

checkpoints.name: kw
checkpoints.description: demonstrations + DAgger rounds 1-3; all inputs, frames weighted by the error of repeating the last command

checkpoints.name: v2
checkpoints.description: behaviour cloning baseline, residual stage 1 (flew DAgger round 1)

checkpoints.name: noact-bc
checkpoints.description: behaviour cloning baseline v2 without the last command

checkpoints.name: stage1_res
checkpoints.description: frozen stage (i) of every policy above except v1: RGB-D ViT encoder and residual JEPA predictor

pilot_missions: mission 0 of every test world was flown by the shield pilots (v1 and v2) before the benchmark; --holdout 1 leaves them out

not_released.latents: latent caches of the non-residual stage 1
